purpose: Select epistemic depth from current risk/evidence signals while enforcing a mandatory research-and-reflection floor for every detected problem and remaining downstream of the always-on mutation sentinel.
principles: The mutation sentinel is always-on and lightweight; adaptive deliberation is not a permanent heavy debate loop.
Once a problem is detected, external research and reflective challenge are mandatory even when the problem appears familiar or local.
Problem size changes research/reflection depth, not whether research/reflection happens.

Move micro -> macro -> micro: reproduce the concrete symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology, consult relevant external evidence, then return to the smallest correct change and concrete verification.
Research must affect diagnosis or repair choice; ceremonial browsing does not satisfy admission.
Reflection must challenge at least one current assumption, boundary, abstraction, topology or causal explanation; repeating the preferred fix is insufficient.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
Counterexample search and independent verification add depth according to risk; they do not decide whether baseline research/reflection starts.

Stop deliberating when evidence is sufficient for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or explicitly bounded, the mutation path is properly mediated, and the plan demonstrably advances the governing done-condition without unnecessary complexity.

mutation_sentinel_contract.responsibility: Before any external/durable mutation, verify authority/target/mutation class and whether the proposed path is mediated by the required host enforcement point; then pass problem/risk signals to adaptive deliberation.
mutation_sentinel_contract.not_a_deliberation_dimension: The sentinel is an admission precondition, not evidence that diagnosis/research/reflection/counterexample work has been completed.

before_mutation: pass the always-on mutation sentinel for the proposed side-effect path
construct current DeliberationSignals from observed evidence rather than from the preferred solution
when a problem is detected, satisfy micro diagnosis, macro/topology alignment, governing-assumption challenge and external research before choosing/promoting the repair
satisfy every additional escalation dimension marked required before promoting the proposed architecture/governance mutation
when counterexample_search_required is true, test at least one plausible alternative or failure counterexample
do not call a same-model critique independent verification
closure_guard: scan all current top-level authorities that can encode the changed semantic, including ENTRYPOINT, CURRENT_SYSTEM, session/binding/authority policies, task/router state and affected domain bindings
scan actual host control surfaces relevant to the claimed invariant, including connector permissions and remote repository protection when mutation safety is in scope
resolve or explicitly bound every contradiction before reporting progress
do not report RESOLVED when a known active production write path can bypass the invariant being claimed
run reproducible evaluation on the final candidate tree and post-promotion observation on production authority at the assurance level appropriate to the change
material_change_admission.host_note: CHATGPT_GITHUB raw connector calls are outside the Python ActionCoordinator. Repository policy therefore requires a host enforcement point for production mutation. Custom Instructions and the model-side sentinel are useful bootstrap/decision aids but are not physical enforcement.

anti_bloat: Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Do not turn guidance principles into accumulating guarantee prose when an invariant can be encoded as a contract/test/fitness property.
